claims.statement: All twelve historical filing objects were recovered with their original hashes; the frozen population is 23,651 nonFraction occurrences.
claims.evidence_level: Historical byte identity and fixed development inventory
limits: Already inspected development material; not a held-out benchmark.

claims.statement: The original execution rejects six ASCII-declared files, producing 8,873 reader observations and retaining 14,778 missing observations in the full denominator.
limits: The audit passes faithful accounting of a failed execution; it does not make the original reader successful.

claims.statement: The separately frozen encoding amendment processes all twelve sources without changing numerical or binding rules; 23,519 common supported conversions agree exactly, 16 are nil and 116 remain unsupported.
limits: Post-inspection engineering amendment, not a pristine confirmatory protocol.
Reference uses pinned Arelle transform functions, not full DTS validation.
Unsupported and nil cases are excluded from agreement, not silently dropped.

claims.statement: Reported bindings resolve for 23,641 occurrences and remain unresolved for ten. Overall status is 23,509 normalized with resolved bindings, 16 nil and 126 unresolved.
limits: Resolved local aspects do not establish taxonomy-valid or financially correct scope.

claims.statement: All 96 predetermined source-derived lookup probes retain the seed occurrence and reject an incorrect source hash; 80 return unique values and 16 retain multiple equal-valued occurrences.
claims.evidence_level: Structured integration self-consistency; descriptive status breakdown
limits: Keys are selected from the same records being queried; no independent QA gold.
Lookup status breakdown is post-execution descriptive analysis.

claims.statement: All 23,651 reference records and 8,873 previously observed typed records are unchanged across attempts; 14,778 typed records are newly processed. All 116 unsupported numeric issues are unsupported transforms, and ten unresolved binding issues concern typed dimensions.
limits: Not a prespecified endpoint; no general semantic equivalence proof.

claims.statement: The amended run verifies fact/context/unit anchors for every occurrence and records 94,895 evidence-byte checks. Separate-agent replay has 763,240 checks and zero failures; the original retained failure has 343,357 checks and zero audit failures.
limits: Anchor checks include repeated dependency checks, not distinct spans.
Replay uses recorded DOM locators/aspect masks and does not establish parser correctness or semantics.

claims.statement: The amended receipt records 610 passing tests plus separate replay of the 68 previous reader controls.
limits: The 68 are repeated controls, not additional new tests or natural QA.

claims.statement: The v14 quantized reader candidate failed to improve matched contexts (1/16 versus 2/16); complete source support was 2/8 paired BM25, 3/8 BM25 closure and 1/8 per tested dense/RRF variant.
limits: Eight known development questions; no broad performance or causal model-size claim.

claims.statement: The contribution under consideration is acquisition of evidence that distinguishes automatically proposed competing bindings; the v16 plan specifies proposer/verifier/selector studies and strong matched-cost baselines.
limits: No end-to-end implementation, natural QA gain or novelty established.
Reader competence, candidate recall, false elimination and independent review remain gates.

claims.statement: Typed numeric agreement and structured lookup do not establish full XBRL conformance, financial truth, rendered grounding or general reader competence.
limits: DTS validation and independently reviewed natural-language evaluation remain separate work.

overarching_limits: Source-only conventional baseline on inspected development filings.
No natural QA predictions, stronger-reader finding, full-DTS conformance, novelty or ACL-readiness claim.
Generic ReportLab PDF and editable uncompiled generic TeX.
Raw source-derived values and captures remain external.
